definitions.explanation: A feeling of admiration and deference toward someone.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}に{深|ふか}い{敬意|けいい}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: I have deep respect for my teacher.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{長年|ながねん}の{努力|どりょく}に{対|たい}して{敬意|けいい}を{表|ひょう}したいと{思|おも}います。
examples.english: I would like to express my respect for his many years of effort.

notes:
{敬意|けいい} is a formal word for respect.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {敬意|けいい}を{表|あらわ}す (to express respect)
- {敬意|けいい}を{払|はら}う (to pay respect)
- {敬意|けいい}を{持|も}つ (to have respect)
- {敬意|けいい}を{込|こ}めて (with respect)

RELATED WORDS:
- {尊敬|そんけい}: respect (general)
- {敬意|けいい}: respect (formal, often in set phrases)
- {尊重|そんちょう}: respect, esteem (for opinions/rights)
